fields.label: Setup Help
fields.options:
Azure AD app registration
1. Entra portal → App registrations → New registration.
2. Add a Web redirect URI = the Redirect URI shown below.
3. Certificates & secrets → new client secret → paste it here.
4. API permissions (Microsoft Graph, Delegated): grant exactly the scopes listed under Delegated Scopes below, plus offline_access openid profile → Grant admin consent.
5. Copy Application (client) ID and Directory (tenant) ID here.

fields.label: Capabilities
fields.description: Pick only what you want. Each is independent, and the Azure permissions asked for at sign-in follow from what is ticked here.

fields.label: Outlook calendar
fields.description: Two-way Event sync, and the Add Teams meeting tickbox on an Event. Needs Calendars.ReadWrite only: Microsoft creates the Teams link as part of the event.

fields.label: Standalone Teams meetings
fields.description: Meetings created on their own rather than on a calendar event, and resolving a join URL back to a meeting. Needs OnlineMeetings.ReadWrite. Leave off if you only want the Teams tickbox on an Event.

fields.label: Meeting transcripts and recordings
fields.description: Reading Teams transcripts (VTT) and recordings. Needs OnlineMeetingTranscript.Read.All, which tenants often refuse; a join URL has to be resolved first, hence standalone meetings above.

fields.label: Outlook mail
fields.description: Mail is handled by Frappe Email Account. This app only sets up and checks the connection.

fields.label: Mail Sign-in Method
fields.description: Delegated: a person signs in. Application: no sign-in, needed for shared mailboxes.

fields.label: Sign in with Microsoft
fields.description: Adds Microsoft as a login option via Frappe Social Login.

fields.label: Capabilities Help
fields.options: Use Set Up to create what each capability needs. Nothing existing is ever modified.

fields.label: Redirect URI
fields.description: Register this exact URI in Azure. Leave blank to use the site default (shown after first save).

fields.label: Delegated Scopes
fields.description: Grant exactly these in Azure. You should not need to edit anything here.

fields.label: Override Delegated Scopes
fields.description: Advanced. Leave empty: scopes are derived from the capabilities above. Fill this in only when your tenant consents to a hand-picked list and sign-in must ask for exactly that, nothing more. Space- or comma-separated; offline_access/openid/profile are always added and must not be listed.

fields.label: Scopes Last Authorised
fields.description: Recorded automatically when someone last authorised a Microsoft Calendar. A token only carries the permissions consented when it was issued, so the doctor compares this with the list above and tells you when connections need re-authorising.
